# Comet Security Policy

English · [中文](SECURITY-zh.md)

## Supported versions

Maintainers prioritize vulnerabilities in the latest publicly released Comet CLI and the corresponding Codex and DeepSeek Harness plugins. Check [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/rpamis/comet/releases/latest) for the current public release. Reports for older versions are welcome. If you can verify whether the latest version is affected, include that result.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Contact the maintainers through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/rpamis/comet/security/advisories/new). Include the affected package or plugin, version, environment, potential impact, and the smallest set of reproduction details or evidence you can share safely. Remove API keys, access tokens, personal information, and private project material before submitting. Discuss the vulnerability in the private report until disclosure is coordinated.

Maintainers use the original report to discuss findings and remediation. When appropriate, they coordinate publication of a security advisory. Use the [issue tracker](https://github.com/rpamis/comet/issues) for ordinary bugs and feature requests.
